milestones.title: The hosted cryptography inventory lists the condition with an item for your organization's authorizing official

remediation: OpenBao holds each site's secrets, its certificate authority and each person's keys, and it is built without a validated module. The request for a FIPS build (issue 1409) is open, and a third party is evaluating a wolfCrypt FIPS build. Record a validated build when one exists. Until then your organization's authorizing official decides whether to accept the condition.
title: OpenBao has no FIPS 140-3 validated build
